description: A low wooden coffee table with a thick rounded rectangular slab tabletop and a smaller inset solid pedestal plinth; natural oak appearance. No separate legs or open lower shelf.
A light gray upholstered three-seat sofa with three broad rectangular back cushions, three rectangular seat cushions, two full padded side armrests, a continuous base, and short wooden feet.
A tall open bookshelf with five horizontal oak shelves attached to two black rectangular metal side frames. No back panel or doors.
A low oak TV console with two slatted wooden sliding front doors, a central open black shelf compartment, a continuous wood top and cabinet body, and a black inset plinth base.
